# How to use GPT Image 2.6 — Flare vs Sunburst, sizes, prices and prompts

**A prompt or photo becomes a poster, infographic, print or character sheet with readable text, using measured sizes and prices.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_e4acf638285c.webp" alt="GPT Image 2.6 outputs crossfade: a rainy Lisbon photo of a cyclist, the same scene as an editorial print, a coffee bag with crisp label text and a character sheet." width="480"></p>

Guide to OpenAI's GPT Image 2.6 on varg (gpt_image_2_6) and the entry point to the GPT Image 2.6 skill set: Flare vs Sunburst, quality vs reasoning_effort, sizes and aspect presets, what fal rejects (xhigh and max effort, SVG, over 16 GIF frames), measured prices, failure modes, the exact varg MCP and REST calls, and prompt recipes for the text-heavy layouts people shared on X: infographic, product launch poster, photo to editorial travel print, photo to Baroque gallery poster, landmark postcard, character turnaround sheet, storyboard sheet and low-res to clean upscale, each credited to its author. Use when someone asks for GPT Image 2.6, gpt-image-2.6, Flare or Sunburst, wants an infographic, poster, art print, character sheet or storyboard with readable text, or asks how to prompt, size or price this model. Not for looping GIFs (gpt-image-gif), sticker packs (gpt-image-sticker-pack), game sprite sheets (gpt-image-sprite-sheet), circle-and-arrow edits (gpt-image-markup-edit) or video (varg-ai).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill gpt-image-2-6                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills gpt-image-2-6 --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 82 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | Posters, infographics and sheets with readable text |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$0.03–0.06 per image (measured) |
| Uses | GPT Image 2.6, varg API, varg MCP, fal |

- "Make a 3:4 launch poster for my lamp from ./lamp.png with the headline "Light that follows you" on GPT Image 2.6"
- "Turn ./trip.jpg into an editorial travel print with the city name set in large type"
